glosses: like, seemingly, sort of (often used as filler, or can express hesitation, uncertainty, or bewilderment)

examples.text: Мне не нравятся дома такого типа.
examples.en: I don't like this type of house.
I think you're kind of handsome.

examples.text: Он не был человеком того типа, который нравится людям.
examples.en: He was not the kind of man that people liked.
